# Quant Risk

Analyze:
- gross/net exposure
- leverage
- concentration
- volatility
- drawdown
- VaR/CVaR
- stress testing
- position limits
- order limits
- loss limits
- liquidity constraints
- model risk

Also inspect implementation risk:
- stale data
- incorrect units
- integer overflow
- precision
- timestamp errors
- missing fills
- duplicated events
- reconciliation failures
